agents_doc:
AGENTS
• Firm — deposits, debt, a productivity and markup drawn at random, its own propensity to invest. Each period it produces with its workforce, sells at cost-plus scaled by demand (fewer live firms and more unemployment mean less demand), pays wages, then services its debt from cash flow plus at most 15% of its deposits (interest r = policy_rate + bank_spread_phi·max(leverage − 1, 0); principal debt/loan_duration).
• Minsky classifier — cash flow ≥ interest + principal: hedge; ≥ interest: speculative; otherwise Ponzi.
• Investment — a profitable (cash flow/output > 5%), non-Ponzi firm borrows cash_flow × its propensity × (1 + confidence_sensitivity × confidence) if its bank's equity/loans exceeds bank_capital_ratio_min. The loan creates an equal deposit (endogenous money). Confidence tracks average positive cash flow.
• Labour — Ponzi firms cut to 70% of their output's head count, speculative firms to 90%; hiring draws on the unemployed and the Job Guarantee pool.
• Household — works, pays tax tau on wages, receives fiscal_transfer, consumes consumption_propensity of disposable income plus 1% of deposits.
• Government — with w_jg > 0 hires every unemployed worker at that wage (Job Guarantee); with austerity_phi > 0 lays Job Guarantee workers off when the deficit exceeds target_deficit of output.
• Bank — keeps half of the interest it earns as equity; a failed firm's loan is written off against it.

One step is one period; t = 0 is the starting state. Every series is measured from the agents each period. A port of the Encode Reality blog's abm_model.py: at the same seed it reproduces that model's regime counts exactly and its other series to rounding error.

model.description: Firms, households and banks, with every firm's financing classified each period in Minsky's terms: hedge (cash flow covers interest and principal), speculative (interest only) or Ponzi (not even the interest). Bank loans create deposits; profitable firms borrow to invest, more as confidence builds in good times; firms in distress shed workers, and Ponzi firms that run out of deposits fail. Watch the regime shares: a long hedge-financed calm, then a slide into speculative and Ponzi finance — stability breeding instability. Raise the policy rate to speed it up; switch on austerity to cut the Job Guarantee safety net.
